FAQs
How does Intercom pricing work?
Intercom pricing has two components:
Seats: You pay per teammate based on your plan (Essential, Advanced, Expert)
Usage: You pay for what you use (e.g. Fin outcomes, messaging channels)
All plans include access to Intercom and Fin AI Agent. Want a tailored estimate? Use the pricing calculator .
How is Fin AI Agent priced?
Fin is priced at $0.99 per outcome .
An outcome is counted when:
A customer confirms their issue is resolved, or
They don’t ask for more help after Fin responds, or
Fin completes a workflow (Procedure), including handoffs
You’re only charged once per conversation, even if multiple questions are answered.
Can I use Fin with my existing helpdesk?
Yes. Fin can be used with tools like Salesforce and others.
Pricing:
$0.99 per outcome
Minimum monthly commitment applies (e.g. 50 outcomes)
No seat costs
No setup, integration, or platform fees
What plans does Intercom offer?
Intercom offers three plans:
Essential
Advanced
Expert
Your plan determines:
Seat price
Feature access
Included capabilities (e.g. Lite seats on higher tiers)
What is a seat (Full vs Lite)?
Full seat: Paid. Required for teammates who interact with customers and use core features.
Lite seat: Free (on Advanced/Expert). Limited access for internal collaboration.
Only Full seats can send messages or fully use features like outbound content.
Are there additional usage charges?
Yes. Beyond seats, pricing is usage-based for certain features:
Fin AI Agent: $0.99 per outcome
WhatsApp: Charged per message sent
SMS: Charged per message (varies by region)
Email campaigns: Charged per bulk email sent
Phone: Usage-based (varies)
Inbound support (e.g. responding to customer emails) is included.
What is Proactive Support Plus?
An optional add-on for outbound engagement.
$99/month includes 500 messages
Covers: Product Tours, Surveys, In-app messages, Mobile Push, Carousels
Additional messages are charged per unit
How much is Copilot?
Copilot is an optional add-on at $29 per agent/month billed annually , or $35 per agent/month billed monthly, for unlimited usage.
Copilot is a personal AI assistant in the Inbox that helps your team resolve conversations faster. Every agent also gets 10 Copilot and 10 AI Auto-translation conversations free each month.
What is the Pro add-on?
Pro is an optional add-on at $100/month , which includes analysis of 500 conversations/month and 6,000 credits per month.
Pro is a set of advanced AI features for managing and improving your support operation. It includes Operator, an agent for customer operations, plus features that help you analyze performance, monitor quality, identify trends, and continuously improve Fin.
Credits are the unit used to measure and charge for Operator usage. Every Pro workspace receives monthly credits, and the number of credits included scales with conversation volume. If you use more credits than what’s included in Pro, you can buy additional credits at $0.01 per credit. Simple actions use fewer credits, while more complex work, like analyzing large sets of conversations, building automation, or testing changes, uses more. You can track usage, set alerts, and use hard limits to control spend.
Do I need a contract?
No.
Monthly or annual self-serve plans are available (Essential, Advanced)
Contracts are optional and required for:
Enterprise needs
Premier Support / onboarding
Custom terms
What’s the minimum to get started?
1 Full seat minimum
No required platform fees beyond that
Usage (e.g. Fin, messaging) is pay-as-you-go
This makes it easy to start small and scale.
Is there a free trial?
Yes.
14-day free trial
No credit card required
Includes all features, Fin, and add-ons
You only pay once you choose a plan and add payment details.
How do I change my plan or seats?
You can:
Upgrade/downgrade plans
Add/remove seats
Add or remove add-ons
Handled directly in your workspace (or via Sales if under contract). Downgrades typically take effect at renewal.
Are there discounts available?
Yes.
Startups: Up to 93% off + 1 year of Fin free (via Early Stage program )
Enterprise discounts may be available via Sales

Intercom Changelog & Release Notes | Product Updates
Go to Intercom
See weekly product updates for Fin AI Agent & Intercom Helpdesk.
Intercom Changelog & Release Notes | Product Updates
New
Reporting
Reuse your saved filters on Fin Performance
Shared by David
• November 06, 2026
Checking how Fin is doing against a specific segment meant rebuilding the same filters every time you opened Fin Performance. Now you can apply any saved filter from your workspace in one click — your selected date range stays as it is.
Everyone on your team can check Fin against the same filters without setting them up again.
Learn more
New
Inbox
Choose a different alert sound for each channel
Shared by Vishal
• November 06, 2026
Teammates can now set a different alert sound for each channel — so you know what’s arrived before you switch tabs.
Go to Settings › Personal › Notifications, turn on Use different sounds per channel, and choose a sound for Chat / Messenger, Email, and Other channels. Choose None to keep the tab blinking without a sound.
Learn more
New feature
Fin
Make changes to Fin with confidence using Releases
Shared by Ben
• November 05, 2026
As Fin takes on more of your support, you’re continuously tuning it: adding content, updating procedures, refining guidance. Until now, each change went live the moment you published it, and could affect how Fin handled conversations elsewhere. Releases give you a separate space to prepare, test and roll out changes to Fin, so nothing reaches customers until you decide it’s ready.
Prepare safely: bundle related content, guidance, escalation guidance and procedures into one release, and review the complete change with your team without touching Main Fin
Test before you trust: preview the release and run Evals against it, so you know your changes work and haven’t broken anything that worked before
Build confidence gradually: roll out to a share of conversations or a specific audience and expand as results come in, or publish to everyone once you’re sure
Prove the impact: run an A/B test against Main Fin to see whether your change moved the metrics you care about
Releases work with the Service agent, on the Intercom Helpdesk and on Fin for platforms.
​
Learn more
AI
Fin
New feature
Fin Evals: Test every change to Fin before it reaches customers
Shared by Kim
• November 05, 2026
Evals is now available to every Fin customer. You can test how Fin handles realistic, multi-turn conversations at scale, so you know how it will behave before a customer ever sees it.
End-to-end coverage: Each Eval tests everything Fin does in a real conversation: drawing on Content, following Guidance, running Procedures and Skills, and using data connectors.
Simulated customers, automated scoring: AI plays the customer and acts as the judge, scoring every conversation against the checks you set.
Catch regressions before they go live: Save your most important scenarios and rerun them after any change, including inside a Release.
Get started: Go to Fin AI Agent > Test > Evals to build your first Eval, or ask Fin Operator to build and run one for you.
Learn more
Messenger
New
See every attachment in one place
Shared by Rosie
• November 04, 2026
No more hunting for files. You can now browse every photo, video, and file from a conversation in the Messenger attachments gallery.
​
Learn more
New
Inbox
Clear your mentions in one go
Shared by Salman
• November 04, 2026
Teammates can now clear mentions in bulk from the Mentions inbox. Select the conversations you want — or select all — then choose Mark as read from the bulk actions menu.
It runs in the background, and only clears your own mentions, so your teammates’ stay untouched.
Learn more
New feature
Fin
Data Connectors
Let Fin Handle Order and Product Questions in Shopify, WooCommerce and BigCommerce
Shared by Mohamed
• November 03, 2026
“Where is my order?” and “do you have this in stock?” are two of the most common support questions — and two of the easiest for Fin to answer, once it’s connected to your store. Add ready-made data connectors for Shopify, WooCommerce, and BigCommerce from the template catalog, and Fin and your workflows can:
Look up a customer’s orders, shipments, refunds, and payment history
Search products, check discount codes and gift card balances
Cancel or update orders, issue refunds and coupons, and update marketing consent
Learn more
Inbox
New feature
Clear reasons and filters for emails in the Spam inbox
Shared by Ben
• November 03, 2026
Until now, legitimate email could sit unanswered in Spam — with only a vague label to explain why, and limited options for finding it. Now every email in Spam says why it was held, in plain words, and you can filter by reason, sender, or recipient to track it down.
Marking an email Not spam now tells you whether the sender was added to your Trusted Senders list. It won’t trust a sender whose email failed verification, so a forged address can’t bypass your spam filter.
Fin AI Agent also stops marking email as spam when it comes from a verified Trusted Senders address — so those customers get an answer.
Learn more here
New feature
Fin
Data Connectors
Let Fin Manage Subscriptions in Stripe, Chargebee, Paddle and Recurly
Shared by Mohamed
• November 03, 2026
Billing requests — checking a subscription, issuing a refund, changing a plan — used to mean a teammate picking up the conversation. Now Fin can handle them directly, using ready-made connectors for Stripe, Chargebee, Paddle, and Recurly from the template catalog.
Look up a customer’s subscriptions, invoices, and payments
Pause, resume, or cancel a subscription, with the customer confirming first
In Stripe: change plans, apply a retention offer, and issue refunds
Learn more
New
Outbound Messaging
Your News site now has an RSS feed
Shared by Marcus
• November 03, 2026
Every News site that allows search engine indexing now publishes an RSS feed of its 50 most recent updates — so readers can follow your product updates without having to come back and check.
Feed readers, browsers, and AI tools can find it automatically and pull in new posts as you publish them. Works on both intercom.news and your own custom domain, with nothing to set up.

Integrations & Migration FAQs
What integrations does Intercom support?
Intercom connects to 450+ first- and third-party apps and integrations, including CRMs like Salesforce and HubSpot, dev tools like Jira, Linear, and Asana, and ecommerce and billing tools like Shopify and Stripe, alongside flexible APIs for everything else.
Which connectors work with Operator and Copilot?
Operator and Copilot have prebuilt MCP connections to Jira, Sentry, Glean, Guru, Slite, Attio, Fullview, Pendo, and Fullstory, with PostHog coming soon. They pull information directly from these tools, with no custom connector setup. Operator is part of the Pro add-on, and Copilot connections are in closed beta.
Can Intercom sync with Salesforce and HubSpot?
Yes. Intercom surfaces key data from tools like Salesforce, Jira, and HubSpot directly in the conversation, so agents act faster without switching tabs.
Can I bring my existing help center content into Intercom?
Yes. Knowledge Hub syncs and imports support content from external platforms including Zendesk, Guru, Confluence, and Notion, so every source lives in one place and powers Fin and Copilot automatically.
What channels can I manage from one inbox?
Email, live chat, phone, SMS, WhatsApp, and social media all route into the same inbox, in 45+ languages, so no conversation lives in a separate tool.
How long does it take to switch from Zendesk to Intercom?
There's no single universal timeline; it depends on your data volume and support hours. Our Expert Services team plans a staged cutover and gives you a concrete plan before you commit, rather than a single big-bang switch.
Do we have to run Zendesk and Intercom at the same time during migration?
A staged cutover is designed to minimize how long you're paying for and managing two systems in parallel, with Expert Services planning the transition around your team's capacity.
Will switching from Zendesk cause downtime?
Migrations are planned in stages specifically to avoid a support gap. Expert Services scopes the cutover with your team so coverage continues throughout the switch.
What happens to our historical tickets and articles when we switch?
Tickets migrate into tickets and conversations, help center articles migrate with a one-click import, and users import via CSV, so historical content and context carry over rather than starting from zero.

FAQs
What is the Intercom Help Center?
The Intercom Help Center is a fully integrated, on-brand knowledge base where your customers find answers to their questions on their own. Your support articles serve across every channel, so customers can self-serve any time, on any channel.
How does the Help Center work with Fin AI Agent to deflect questions?
Your Help Center content powers Fin AI Agent, which resolves 76% of support questions on average, with many customers seeing 85%+. Articles also surface in the Messenger before customers reach out, your team can add them to conversations from the Inbox , and Outbound automatically sends them when and where they’re needed. Learn more about omnichannel support .
How do I customize my Help Center without code?
The no-code Help Center Styler lets you customize layout, colors, and fonts to match your brand identity, with no code required. You can also format articles with rich media, CTAs, and tables to make your content more engaging.
How does Intercom support multiple brands and languages?
You can create individually branded Help Centers for each of your brand entities and manage them all in one workspace. Instant translation supports 45 languages, including English, Spanish, French, Mandarin, and Hindi.

Article Targeting delivers specific content to customers based on attributes like location and pricing plan, and Article Suggestions surface relevant articles before customers start searching.
